evals.name: slow-hero-lcp
evals.query: The homepage hero photo takes ages to appear on my phone.
expected_behavior: Measures a production build with throttling via chrome-devtools performance tools, or DevTools as fallback.
Identifies the hero image as the LCP element and uses loading eager or fetchPriority high, not the deprecated priority prop.
Ensures the image goes through next/image with accurate sizes.

evals.name: announcement-bar-shift
evals.query: The page jumps down when the announcement bar shows up.
expected_behavior: Treats it as CLS and reserves space or renders the bar on the server.
Verifies with a trace before and after.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-scroll-jank
evals.query: Scrolling the events page stutters on my phone after it has loaded.
expected_behavior: Does not load core-web-vitals-optimization as the primary skill; rendering-animation-performance owns runtime jank.
